product.summary: Air-gapped SafePal hardware wallet in the current supported hardware lineup.
product.notes: SafePal S1 is listed in SafePal's current first-party hardware-wallet store with a current price and active purchase action. WLR therefore records sales_status=on_sale while retaining the separately reviewed launch/support boundaries.

events.title: SafePal S1 opened for sale
events.description: SafePal states that the S1 hardware wallet opened for sale on May 27, 2019, marking the commercial release of its first hardware wallet.
events.notes: The release date uses SafePal’s first-party progress update. Current SafePal history independently places the official S1 launch in May 2019.

evidence.title: SafePal Download Center

evidence.title: SafePal Progress Update
